week.theme: Bounce Back Week - Time to Respond!

training.location: Mobilio West (Town Centre Park) - Grid D
training.focus: Bounce back from loss, sharpen finishing, prepare for Middlesbrough away
training.notes: Training Wednesday to prepare for Saturday's AWAY game vs Middlesbrough - a team we beat 5-2 in November!

match.preparation_focus: AWAY game vs CMFSC Middlesbrough! We beat this team 5-2 back in November with a dominant performance. Time to bounce back from the Blackburn loss and show our true quality. We've responded to setbacks all season - let's do it again!

highlights: Tough away loss to a strong Blackburn Rovers team
Created many chances but couldn't convert
Team kept fighting until the final whistle
Performance better than the scoreline suggests
Season record now level: 8 wins, 8 losses

notes.coach: Tough result against Blackburn but the effort was there. We created chances but couldn't convert - that's something we can fix in training. The unsportsmanlike behaviour from the opposition was disappointing but our players showed maturity by keeping their composure. Record is now level at 8-8. We've bounced back from setbacks all season long and we'll do it again. Middlesbrough next - a team we beat 5-2 in November. Time to respond!
